x: The G20 troika comprises the previous, current and next presidencies (B). In 2022 it was Italy (previous, 2021), Indonesia (current, 2022) and India (next, 2023). The G20 has no permanent secretariat, and the troika is not based on economic size or on G7/BRICS/EU.

The Maratha Military Landscapes were inscribed at the 47th World Heritage Committee session in Paris in 2025 (B). Deepavali was inscribed at the 20th ICH Committee (Red Fort, New Delhi, Dec 2025), not a World Heritage Committee in Paris; Sarnath was inscribed at the 48th session in Busan (July 2026), not the 43rd General Conference in Samarkand (that conference named Lucknow a gastronomy city); and the Hoysala temples were inscribed in September 2023, not at Busan in 2026.

NPT (signed 1968, in force 1970) controls the spread of nuclear weapons (iii); CTBT (1996) bans all nuclear tests (iv); NSG (1975) controls nuclear materials and technology (i); MTCR (1987) covers missiles and drones capable of 500 kg over 300 km (ii). So a–iii, b–iv, c–i, d–ii (A).
